items.name: Drowned Pact
items.description:
Forged from blackened coral and rimmed with scavenged pearls and barnacle-ridden iron, this arcane collar bears glowing runes pulsing faintly with abyssal pink light. Crafted by sahuagin deep-priests, the Collar of the Drowned Pact was originally designed to keep surface dwellers alive—but docile—when taken as slaves or emissaries to the depths.
